title: HER Console
description: Smooth and sleek on the outside. Fun and rich on the inside — like a well-tailored Paul Smith suit.
feature: Painted interiors, brass trim, fluted fronts
story: I don't really have project favorites. But some leave a dent in my heart. This one is that.

From the first drawing to the final install, I was excited to make it real. I believe results like this only happen when client and builder truly understand each other — when there's trust, freedom, and real communication on both sides.
Smooth and sleek on the outside. Fun and rich on the inside — like a well-tailored Paul Smith suit.
And a huge mirror with a precise cutout to fit the console. No buttons. Light appears with a glide of your hand along the curve. All sensors hidden, tracking motion in silence.
Really proud of this one. Will miss her.
detail_1_value: Fluted lacquered fronts. Glass top. Every surface flush — nothing interrupts the line.
detail_2_value: Custom cutout to the millimeter. The console and mirror read as one object.
detail_3_value: Hand-painted drawer boxes. Brass inlay trim. A private world inside a composed exterior.
